title: Shelf bracket
about: an L-bracket with a gusset and four M4 countersunk holes, printed on its side so the bending load runs along the layers
tries: Add a lip at the end of the arm that stops the shelf sliding off | Make the gusset hollow: a triangular frame 5 mm wide

agent.role: a hardware designer who orients load-bearing printed parts for their bending load
agent.prompt: Prefer printing brackets on their side with gussets flush with the bed face; size screw holes with j.hole.countersink and a fit class; never put a hole where a screwdriver cannot reach it.

fragments.beam: Check the arm as a beam: σ = M / Z with Z = b·t²/6, at the section where the gusset ends.
fragments.screws: Use M4 countersunk wood screws into the wall and the shelf; M5 for loads over 15 kg.
